data.name: SURROUNDED
data.detailed_description:
You weren’t lost. You were placed here.

SURROUNDED is a first-person psychological horror experience where the line between system and stalker blurs. The world feels familiar, controlled, almost bureaucratic—until it isn’t.

More information coming soon.

content_descriptors.notes: SURROUNDED contains intense survival horror elements, including jump scares, frightening atmosphere, depictions of blood, and violence from hostile entities. While there is no sexual or satanic content, the game’s tone and visuals are designed to be unsettling and may not be suitable for all audiences.
